CreateRide.title: Post your ride
CreateRide.description: Create and share a new ride with the community.
CreateRide.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Sunday Coffee Ride to your favorite cafe
CreateRide.locationHint: Tap to pick on the map
CreateRide.startPointNameHint: Riders see this name — be specific (e.g. “by the fountain”).

coffee_ride.label: Coffee ride
coffee_ride.description: Social ride with a café stop.

sightseeing.label: Sightseeing
sightseeing.description: A ride focused on visiting interesting places along the route.

training.label: Training
training.description: Structured effort — intervals, pace work, zones.

no_drop.label: No drop
no_drop.description: Nobody gets left behind — the group waits for everyone.

regroup.label: Regroup
regroup.description: We wait at the top of climbs or at set meeting points.

drop.label: Drop
drop.description: Hold the wheel or ride home alone.

slowest_rider.label: Slowest rider
slowest_rider.description: The group rides at the pace of whoever is slowest.

leader.label: Set by leader
leader.description: The leader holds a declared average pace.

group_split.label: Group split
group_split.description: The group splits into pace groups along the way.

free.label: Free
free.description: No set formation — ride where you like, just stay predictable and safe.

leader.label: Designated riders lead
leader.description: Designated riders stay on the front — nobody passes unless they call a change.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Everyone takes a turn on the front, swapping at set intervals.

first_timers.label: First timers welcome
first_timers.description: No experience needed — we’ll show you how a group ride works.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.description: Group riding basics expected: hand signals, holding a wheel, a steady line.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: For riders who sleep with their bike — high pace, tight formation, turns on the front.
